prompts.title: Summarize selection
prompts.body:
Summarize the following in 5 bullet points:

{{selection}}

prompts.title: Explain simply
prompts.body:
Explain this simply, with one concrete example:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.title: Code review
prompts.body:
Review this code for bugs, security issues and readability. Be specific and concise:

{{code}}

prompts.title: Compare options
prompts.body: Compare {{option_a}} and {{option_b}} for {{use_case}}. Use a table, then give a recommendation and say what would change it.

prompts.title: Research a company
prompts.body: Give me a sourced profile of {{company}}: what they do, funding, leadership, main competitors and recent news.

prompts.title: Fact-check a claim
prompts.body:
Fact-check this claim. Cite sources and say what is right, wrong or uncertain:

{{claim}}

prompts.title: Translate and explain
prompts.body:
Translate to {{language}} and explain any idioms or tricky words:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Debug an error
Literature scan
prompts.body: Find the most cited and most recent papers on {{topic}}. For each: authors, year, one-line finding, and a link.

prompts.title: Meeting briefing
prompts.body: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with {{person_or_company}} about {{topic}}: background, recent news, likely questions, and points to raise.

prompts.title: From beginner to expert
prompts.body: Teach me {{topic}} in three levels: beginner, intermediate and expert. Finish with the 5 most common mistakes.

prompts.title: Pros and cons
prompts.body: Give an honest list of pros and cons of {{decision}}, then say what information would change your conclusion.

prompts.title: Decision memo
prompts.body: Write a one-page decision memo for {{decision}}. Include context, the options considered, evaluation criteria with weights, a recommendation, risks with mitigations, and the first three actions.

prompts.title: Pre-mortem
prompts.body: Assume {{project}} failed six months from now. List the 10 most likely reasons, rank them by likelihood times impact, and give one early-warning signal and one prevention for each of the top five.

prompts.title: Steelman both sides
prompts.body: Give the strongest honest case for and against {{position}}. For each side name the best evidence, the weakest assumption, and the question a fair critic would ask.

prompts.title: Rubber-duck debugging
prompts.body:
Act as a rubber duck. Ask me up to 5 targeted questions, one at a time, to locate the root cause before proposing any fix:

{{problem}}

prompts.title: Minimal reproduction
prompts.body:
Reduce this to a minimal reproducible example. Remove everything not needed to trigger the problem, list your assumptions, and state expected versus actual behaviour:

{{code}}

prompts.title: Safe refactor plan
prompts.body:
Propose a step-by-step refactor of this code where every step is independently shippable and preserves behaviour. For each step name the risk and a command or check that verifies it:

{{code}}

prompts.title: Edge-case checklist
prompts.body:
List the edge cases and failure modes for this code or spec, grouped by input, state, concurrency and environment. Give a one-line check idea for each:

{{code}}

prompts.title: Commit message from a diff
prompts.body:
Write a Conventional Commits message for this diff: an imperative subject under 72 characters, a body explaining why, and a breaking-change footer if needed:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.title: Pull request description
prompts.body:
Write a pull request description for this change with sections: summary, motivation, what changed, how to verify, risks and rollback. Be specific and do not invent behaviour that is not in the diff:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.title: Explain and optimize SQL
prompts.body:
Explain what this SQL does step by step, flag performance problems, and suggest indexes or rewrites. State which database you assume and what you would measure first:

{{sql}}

prompts.title: Regex builder
prompts.body: Write a regular expression for {{goal}} in {{flavor}}. Show matching and non-matching examples, explain each part, and mention catastrophic-backtracking risks.

prompts.title: API design review
prompts.body:
Review this API design for naming, consistency, error handling, pagination, versioning, idempotency and security. List problems by severity with a concrete fix for each:

{{spec}}

prompts.title: Quick threat model
prompts.body: Threat-model {{system}} using STRIDE. List assets, trust boundaries and the top threats with likelihood, impact and a mitigation. Finish with the three fixes to do first.

prompts.title: Reply to an email
prompts.body:
Draft a reply to this email in a {{tone}} tone, under {{length}} words. Answer every question asked and end with a clear next step:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.title: Rewrite for clarity
prompts.body:
Rewrite the following for clarity and concision without changing the meaning. Show the rewrite, then list the five most important changes you made:

{{selection}}

prompts.title: Source credibility check
prompts.body:
Assess the credibility of this source or claim: who published it, the quality of the evidence, conflicts of interest, and independent corroboration. Give a verdict and what to check next:

{{claim}}

prompts.title: Build a timeline
prompts.body: Build a dated timeline of {{topic}}. Cite a source for each entry and mark anything disputed or uncertain.

prompts.title: 30-day learning plan
prompts.body: Create a 30-day plan to learn {{skill}} with {{hours}} hours per week. Give weekly goals, specific exercises, one small project, and how I will know I am improving.

prompts.title: Make flashcards
prompts.body:
Turn this text into 15 spaced-repetition flashcards (question and answer) that test understanding rather than recall of wording:

{{selection}}

prompts.title: Find contradictions
prompts.body:
Read the text and list internal contradictions, unsupported claims and undefined terms. Quote the exact passages:

{{selection}}

prompts.title: Summary at three lengths
prompts.body:
Summarize the following three ways: one sentence, one paragraph, and a bullet list of key points that keeps every important number:

{{selection}}

prompts.title: Meeting notes to actions
prompts.body:
Turn these notes into decisions, action items with owner and due date (write TBD when unknown), and open questions:

{{clipboard}}

prompts.title: Negotiation prep
prompts.body: Help me prepare to negotiate {{topic}} with {{counterparty}}. Give my likely interests and theirs, a target and a walk-away point, concessions to trade, and likely objections with replies.

prompts.title: Trip planner with sources
prompts.body: Plan a {{days}}-day trip to {{destination}} for {{travelers}} on a {{budget}} budget. Group by day, include travel times, current opening hours and booking links where available, and a rainy-day alternative.

prompts.title: Buying guide
prompts.body: Research the best {{product}} for {{need}} under {{budget}}. Compare the top five on the criteria that matter, cite recent reviews, and say who should pick each one.
